ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible distribution shows a ratio of approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels to 65% low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling is concentrated on the lateral regions of both lobes. Distinct dark focal spots (circular pixel clusters) are embedded within the white patches, particularly visible on the distal segments of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp interior angle and a defined depth leading toward the midline of the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel fluctuations (peaks and valleys) from the median notch to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning into a convex curve at the outermost distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially concentrated clusters of dark, roughly circular pixel groups are detected on the white lateral regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Rough, high-relief pixel clusters with tan and brown hues are visible on the extreme outer tips of both lobes, indicating parasitic or barnacle colonization.
